thread:
slo-bot: SLO ALERT: hosted-infer /v1/generate 5xx-rate = 0.72% over last 6m (threshold 0.5%). Region: us-west. Incident INF-20260317-1 :rotating_light:

maya: seeing a bunch of support tickets where customers hit 502 + long tails. ticket #9872, #9875. p95/p99 latency also elevated.

ashok: pulling dashboards now. can someone paste the cluster + route header if available?

lucas: quick kibana query I ran: `service:hosted-infer AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599] AND http.path:"/v1/generate"` - returns ~340 events in 10m, concentrated on gateway-node-07 and gateway-node-02. sampling=10% so real count higher.

caroline: Sentry shows repeated UpstreamTimeoutError with upstream host `inference-gateway-02.usw` - stacktrace points to outbound call to `model-proxy:443` timing out. many entries have no trace id (trace sampling dropped).

maya: support-bot reported customer complaint saying `curl` returns 502 intermittently with `read timeout` after ~10s. example from ticket: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```

ashok: looks like client-side retry + our rate limiter could be compounding. checking rate limiter logs. also noticed some 429s around same time from edge.

ops-jamie: jumping in — I see a spike in tcp retransmits on gateway-node-07 starting 10:02 UTC. kernel dropped some keepalive packets after a kernel upgrade yesterday (4.19->5.x) on that host.

lucas: interesting — that could explain partial traces missing if connections reset before trace set is emitted. can we correlate with metrics? prom query: `sum(rate(tcp_retransmit_total{instance=~"gateway-node-07.*"}[1m]))` -> spike coincident with SLO alert.

caroline: also found logs showing `UpstreamError: 504 Gateway Timeout` with message `context deadline exceeded` from model-proxy, but headroom for kv-cache hits is OK. suggests handshake/timeouts rather than backend overload.

maya: support-bot to customers: we acknowledged, asking for sample request IDs.

support-bot: Sent automated note to affected customers asking for `x-request-id` and approx timestamps. some replied with IDs: req-7f3a, req-7f3b.

ashok: repro plan: 1) reproduce against gateway-node-07 with high concurrency to see if tcp retransmit correlates with 502s. 2) roll traffic off node-07 via weight=0 in routing for 15m 3) check if SLO clears.

ops-jamie: agreed. scheduling quick traffic shift to drain node-07 now. doing `kubectl patch` to adjust service weights.

lucas: patch applied. live-dashboard: route /v1/generate error-rate dropped from 0.7% -> 0.12% in 3m. p99 latency trending down.

maya: great. can we add a follow-up to revert kernel upgrade on node-07 and run soak? also need postmortem: missing traces and sampling changes made debug hard.

ops-jamie: will coordinate kernel rollback with infra team and open a follow-up change to fix keepalive defaults.

caroline: we should increase trace sampling temporarily on affected services for 24h to catch any residual errors.

maya: thanks all. I'm updating ticket #9872 with mitigation steps and ETA for rollback. closing incident INF-20260317-1 as mitigated; monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
